TSG RAN2#120 was a hybrid meeting where remote participants could join the meeting via Internet, submit contributions and discuss them, but not object decisions. There were 118 numbered email discussions during this meeting. The topics discussed were: -NR Rel-15, Rel-16 and Rel-17, NR IAB enhancements, NR Feature Lists and UE Capabilities, UE Power Saving, NR Non-Public Network enhancements, NR feMIMO, TEI17, NR and MR-DC measurement gap enhancements, Uplink Data Compression (UDC), NR R17 Other, Further NR mobility enhancements, Mobile IAB for NR, Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning for NR air interface NR, R18 Other - Johan Johansson (Chair) -LTE corrections Rel-16 and earlier, MR DC/CA further enhancements, RAN slicing, NR QoE, Extending NR operation to 71GHz, Rel-17 EUTRA common, X
